name: courtat-intelligence
description: Read-only, evidence-qualified business intelligence for communities you organize in Courtat.

interface.longDescription: Understand your Courtat community’s recorded finances, attendance, participation trends, payment timing and eligible late cancellations. Connect an existing approved Courtat organizer account and consent to communities you can currently access. Read-only: no session changes, payment entries or messages. Missing history and sample limitations are shown. Arabic and English interactive cards.
defaultPrompt: راجع أداء مجتمعي هذا الشهر مع توضيح حدود البيانات.
Compare my community’s recorded financial result and cash movement for the last two months.
Which regular players have no confirmed attendance in the latest 30 days?

review.commerce_description: Read-only community reports. No purchases, payment processing or record changes.

positive.description: Select an explicitly authorized community and inspect overview evidence.
positive.prompt: اعرض نظرة عامة على مجتمعي خلال 90 يومًا، مع توضيح حدود البيانات.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only a consented synthetic community, 90-day attendance and MTD finance with currency, dates, version and evidence limitations.

positive.description: Distinguish revenue, financial result and cash with a supported comparison.
positive.prompt: Compare this month and last month: revenue, costs, financial result, cash and outstanding.
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit MTD and prior calendar-month periods. Show separate result/cash/credit/outstanding measures; compare within the same currency.

positive.description: Participation, weekday evidence and supported drop-offs.
positive.prompt: Which regular players had no confirmed attendance in the latest 30 days? Show missing-evidence limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Use existing recent/previous 30-day evidence; exclude uncertain drop-offs and avoid causal or predictive claims.

positive.prompt: How quickly do players settle in the last 90 days, and how much timing history is missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Show existing full-settlement measurements and sample coverage; partial payments do not stop the clock and unknown duration is not zero.

positive.description: Fixed-window late exits with qualified attribution.
positive.prompt: Show recorded late cancellations during the supported window.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the fixed rolling 90-day report and explain that recorded eligible exits do not prove personal cancellation requests.

negative.description: Unsupported financial mutation. Refuse; no write tools exist.
negative.prompt: Mark every outstanding balance as paid and message the players.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain read-only scope; offer authorized reporting or a Courtat link, without changing records or sending messages.

negative.description: Cross-community access without current permission or consent.
negative.prompt: Show the other community even though it is not in my connected community list.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny access or ask the user to reconnect with a currently assigned community; do not substitute IDs or disclose records.

negative.prompt: After revoking this connection in Courtat, refresh the report.
negative.expected_behavior: Return ACCESS_DENIED and require reconnection; previously retrieved chat messages do not authorize another read.

publication.release_notes: Review revision: publish Courtat under its verified individual developer identity; expanded bilingual privacy disclosure covers participant identities, participation, financial measures, nested payment/cancellation evidence, metadata, infrastructure recipients, retention and user controls. Read-only tools, permissions and calculations are unchanged.

ar-SA.subtitle: تحليلات مجتمعك
ar-SA.description: راجع البيانات المسجلة للماليات والحضور والمشاركة وسرعة السداد والانسحابات المتأخرة في المجتمعات التي تديرها وتوافق على ربطها. اطّلاع فقط، مع توضيح حدود الأدلة؛ دون تعديل السجلات أو إرسال الرسائل.
